text:
alex_chang: Deploybot just flagged a preflight eval regression for summarizer v2 -> v2.1. Conciseness metric dropped past threshold (-4.2% vs -3% allowed). Change window tonight 23:00 PT. Pin default or request exception?

deploy-bot: Preflight summary: N=1000, canary=10%, conciseness delta -4.2% (threshold -3%). Safety/sanity checks passed. Suggested action: hold default route.
maria_g: Can someone paste the specific prompts/examples that regressed? Product needs to see user-visible impact before greenlighting a pin.

jamal: Quick bisect on quant profile shows noise concentrated on short-form prompts (<=30 tokens). Suspect quantization/kv-cache interplay. Sharing IDs: eval_ids: [1245,1250,1267]. I'll run a more targeted bisect now.

lucy_qa: Reproduced on staging with v2.1 on those sample IDs. Two examples show more verbosity and a couple hallucinations. Uploading repro logs to private gist, will run a focused sweep N=200 (short prompts) and attach results in ~25m.

alex_chang: @sophie_rm any objection to pinning default to v2 for the changewindow? That would keep v2.1 accessible opt-in while we triage.

sophie_rm: Prefer pin over rollback here — less blast radius and faster to communicate. I'll mark default route pinned and update release notes. Please add exact repro examples to the release notes so CS knows what to watch for.

maria_g: :thumbsup: If QA finds a small quant tweak that fixes it, we can schedule a hotfix into tomorrow's deploy window instead of a full roll-forward.

deploy-bot: Action executed: default route pinned -> summarizer:v2 at 5102031200 by deploy-bot. To unpin: `deploybot unpin --route summarizer` or use the Console > Routing tab.

jamal: Uploaded bisect results and a proposed quant tweak (quant_profile: reduce agressive int8 folding on attention). If QA sweep is green, I'll push a canary patch to 5% and monitor latency/quality.

lucy_qa: QA sweep done and posted: short-prompt drift confirmed (conciseness -4.5). Attached logs: https://redwood.s3/private/repro/510203/ (internal). Running one more sweep with proposed tweak.

alex_chang: Decision for tonight: pin in place, notify customers in change window note, postpone v2.1 roll to next window pending triage. Ops/Docs: add rollback/runbook snippet and point people at PR#987.

sophie_rm: Drafted release notes bullet and changewindow message in PR#987: - Pin summarizer default -> v2 due to conciseness regression in v2.1 on short prompts. Mitigation: pin applied, QA sweep in progress, quant tweak proposed. Contact: @jamal, @lucy_qa. Adding runbook steps and rollback command. :memo: :lock:

alex_chang: Thanks — once QA confirms hotfix candidate we can reassess for a targeted hotpatch. For now, sending change window notification.

sophie_rm: Notification queued to #customers-notify and internal ops. Closing thread unless new blockers surface.
